skills.elemental_skill: Tighnari throws a Vijnana Stormheart ahead that deals AoE Dendro DMG, creating a Vijnana-Khanda Field that creates mysterious illusions that taunt opponents and draw their fire. Additionally, Tighnari gains the Vijnana Suffusion effect, which will decrease the Wreath Arrow's charging time by. This effect will dissipate once the skill duration ends or after Tighnari has fired Wreath Arrows. When this skill hits at least one enemy, it generates Elemental Particles. The Vijnana Suffusion effect is depicted by the seeds floating around Tighnari's left shoulder. They will disappear as Tighnari shoots Wreath Arrows, or when the Vijnana Suffusion effect ends.
